explanation: Programmer Kazuhisa Hashimoto added it to Gradius in the 1980s because he found the game too hard to test. Contra later made it famous by giving players 30 lives.

claims.text: The cheat sequence 'up, up, down, down, left, right, left, right, B, A' is known as the Konami Code.
The cheat is not named after Capcom, Namco or Taito.
Kazuhisa Hashimoto created the code for the home version of Gradius in the mid-1980s because he found the game too difficult while testing it.
In Contra, entering the Konami Code gives the player 30 lives.
